answer: One operator's vocabulary is stable: the same favourite words, the same rare words, week after week. The network builds a vocabulary profile per account and compares new sessions against it; a session whose word choice suddenly matches a generic model instead of the account's own profile is flagged. A falcon out of place triggers the check: the session is frozen until its pattern clears. A orchard alone is noise; a mesa of consistent sessions is a pattern the network can trust.
